message.reasoning:
We have to decide post-turn action. Player Alpha has cash 450. Holdings: Reading Railroad, Electric Company, St James Place (1 house), Tennessee Avenue (1 house), New York Avenue (1 house). Buildable spaces: those three (they are a color set? St James, Tennessee, New York are orange set). Already have 1 house each. Could build more houses. Need to consider cash and houses remaining: bank has 18 houses left. Building houses costs: St James Place cost? In Monopoly, orange properties: St. James Place $180, Tennessee Avenue $180, New York Avenue $200. House cost per property is $100 each (I think). Actually house cost for orange is $100. So each house costs $100. So building a second house on each would cost $300 total. Could also build a hotel later after 4 houses each. Currently each has 1 house. Could also mortgage properties: Electric Company and Reading Railroad. Mortgage values: Electric Company mortgage $75? Actually Electric Company mortgage $75. Reading Railroad mortgage $100. Mortgaging gives cash but reduces assets. Might be useful to raise cash for building houses or future purchases. Cash 450 is decent. Could build houses to increase rent. Opponents: Beta has 3 orange properties but no houses. Actually Beta holds Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois (red set). So not competing for orange. Gamma has no holdings. Delta has none. So building houses on orange set will increase rent when Alpha lands there (or others land). Since Alpha is on FREE_PARKING, next turn will roll dice. Could be beneficial to have houses now.

Also could consider trading. But no trade options now; only post-turn actions include building, mortgaging, end turn. Could also mortgage to get cash for later purchases (like buying unowned properties when landing). But we have cash 450, enough to buy many. Unowned spaces include many cheap ones. Might want to keep cash for buying when landing. But building houses now will increase rent and also cost cash now, reducing ability to buy later. However houses are good long-term.

What is the best action? Probably build houses on orange set to increase rent. Could build one house on each? Already have 1 each. Could add one more house to each (total 2 each) costing $300, leaving cash 150. That seems reasonable. Could also build on just one property to maximize rent? But balanced building is required (must build evenly). So can add one house to each of the three, costing $300. That leaves cash 150, still enough for some purchases.

Thus choose build_houses_or_hotel with plan: for each space_key, count 1, kind HOUSE.

Make public message maybe "Building houses to improve my orange set." Private thoughts: reasoning.

Let's do tool call.
